tagline: A best-in-class, mission-driven life science REIT making a positive and lasting impact on the world.
hero_kpi_rationale: Occupancy Rate is the primary key performance indicator for a REIT as it directly reflects leasing demand, asset quality, and the ability to generate stable rental income. In the life science segment, a high rate demonstrates a dominant position within strategic innovation clusters.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased space relative to total available square footage.
kpis.description: An occupancy rate of 90.9% at the end of 2025 indicates strong demand, although slightly below the 10-year historical average of 95%.
kpis.signal: Strong occupancy in a demanding sector, though slightly below historical average.

kpis.name: Total Properties
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate assets held across the portfolio.
kpis.description: 340 properties in North America, including some through joint ventures, reflecting a leading geographic position.
kpis.signal: Extensive portfolio concentrated in life science innovation hubs.

kpis.name: Operating Rentable Square Feet
kpis.explanation: Total square feet currently in operation, expressed in millions of rentable square feet.
kpis.description: 35.9 million rentable square feet operational at the end of 2025, complemented by 3.5 million under construction.

kpis.name: Under Construction Rentable Square Feet
kpis.explanation: Square footage currently under development, expressed in millions of rentable square feet.
kpis.description: 3.5 million rentable square feet under construction at the end of 2025, indicating ongoing portfolio expansion.
kpis.signal: Significant development pipeline to address future demand.

kpis.name: Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total market value of outstanding shares.
kpis.description: Market capitalization of $20.75 billion at the end of 2025.

kpis.name: Investment Grade Tenant Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of annual rental revenue derived from investment-grade rated tenants or large publicly traded corporations.
kpis.description: 53% of annual revenue comes from investment-grade or large publicly traded tenants.
kpis.signal: Solid and diversified tenant base, reducing credit risk.

kpis.name: 10-Year Average Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Average occupancy rate over the past decade.
kpis.description: The 10-year average occupancy rate is 95%, compared to 90.9% in 2025, indicating recent pressure on occupancy levels.
kpis.signal: High historical stability, despite recent slight deterioration.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation is mentioned as a risk factor in the annual report, with potential impact on the company's operating results. The company's positioning in the 10-K and the intensity of the language used suggest a significant risk.

risks.title: Asset Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company has recorded significant impairment charges on its assets, suggesting a high risk of asset value loss. The company's positioning in the 10-K and the intensity of the language used suggest an existential risk.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces credit risks related to its loans and investments, which could negatively impact its operating results. The company's positioning in the 10-K and the intensity of the language used suggest a significant risk.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which could negatively affect its operating results. The company's positioning in the 10-K and the intensity of the language used suggest a moderate risk.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that could negatively impact its operating results. The company's positioning in the 10-K and the intensity of the language used suggest a moderate risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company ARE does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report for the 2025 fiscal year. No references to AI are present in the provided excerpts.
